en.ml.hl.hint.model: High sounds are thin and squeaky. Low sounds are deep.
en.ml.same.instruction: Listen to them both. Are they the same?
en.ml.same.hint.model: Listen to the first one. Then listen to the second one.
en.ml.beat.instruction: Listen to the beat. Then tap the drum with it.
en.ml.beat.incorrect: Not quite with the beat. Listen, and try again.
en.ml.beat.hint.model: Listen first. Then tap each time the light comes on.
en.ml.again.tune.instruction: Listen to the big bird. Who sings the same tune?
en.ml.again.drum.instruction: Listen to the big drum. Who plays the same?
en.ml.again.incorrect: That one was different. Listen again.
en.ml.again.hint.model: Listen to the big one. Then listen to each little one.
en.ml.tune.up.instruction: Make a tune that goes up.
en.ml.tune.down.instruction: Make a tune that goes down.
en.ml.tune.hill.instruction: Make a tune that goes up, and then comes down.
en.ml.tune.twice.instruction: Make a little tune. Then play the same again.
en.ml.tune.home.instruction: Make a tune that ends on the biggest bar.
en.ml.tune.up.incorrect: That did not go up every time. Change it, and try again.
en.ml.tune.down.incorrect: That did not go down every time. Change it, and try again.
en.ml.tune.hill.incorrect: Go up first. Then come down.
en.ml.tune.twice.incorrect: The second half has to be the same as the first.
en.ml.tune.home.incorrect: It has to end on the biggest bar.
en.ml.tune.up.hint: Start on a big bar. Then choose a smaller one each time.
en.ml.tune.down.hint: Start on a small bar. Then choose a bigger one each time.
en.ml.tune.hill.hint: Go to smaller bars first. Then come back to bigger ones.
en.ml.tune.twice.hint: Choose two bars. Then choose the same two again.
en.ml.tune.home.hint: Play any bars you like. Play the biggest bar last.

skills.title: Tell a high note from a low one
skills.objective: Hears two or three notes sung by birds that look alike, and taps the one that was high — or, when asked, the one that was low — when the notes are as little as a third apart.

skills.title: Say whether two short tunes are the same
skills.objective: Hears two tunes of three or four notes, or two drum patterns, one after the other, and says whether they were the same or different when only one note or one knock is changed.

skills.title: Tap along with a slow, steady beat
skills.objective: Taps a drum in time with a beat of 60 to 84 to the minute, meeting at least six beats of eight within a generous margin. This is rough tempo, not precision.

skills.title: Play back a few notes in order
skills.objective: Hears three or four notes played on chime bars and plays them back in the same order.

skills.title: Know a tune again when it comes back
skills.objective: Hears a tune of three or four notes and then two or three more, and picks out the one that was the first tune again from others with the same notes in another order.

skills.title: Make up a tune with a shape
skills.objective: Makes up a tune of three to six notes on chime bars that goes up, goes down, climbs and comes back, says the same thing twice, or comes home to the lowest bar, as asked.

lessons.title: High and low
lessons.summary: Two notes are played, and your child taps the one that was high — or, when asked, the one that was low. First they are on chime bars, where the small bar can be seen to be the high one, and far apart. Later birds that look alike sing them, closer together, so that only listening will do.

choices.label: A chime bar: very high C
A chime bar: very high C
A chime bar: very high E

lessons.title: The same, or different?
lessons.summary: Two birds sing a short tune each — or two drums play a short pattern each — and your child says whether the two were the same or different. The first differences are big ones: a tune that goes up against one that comes down. Later only one note, or one long knock, is changed.

lessons.title: Tapping with the beat
lessons.summary: A slow, steady beat is played and lit up along a strip: four beats to listen to, then some to join in with on a big drum. Nothing has to be exact. Most of the beats met, give or take a good margin, is keeping the beat, and a tablet that answers a little late is allowed for.

lessons.title: Play it back
lessons.summary: A few notes are played on chime bars, each bar lighting as it sounds, and your child plays them back in the same order: two notes at first, then three, then four. Hearing the notes again is help, and is asked for as help. With the sound off the bars still light, so the order can be followed by eye.

lessons.title: The same tune again
lessons.summary: A big bird sings a short tune. Then two or three little birds sing one each, and your child finds the one that sang the big bird’s tune again. The others are nearly the same: the same notes in another order, or one note changed. Some questions are for drums, with long and short knocks.

lessons.title: Make a tune
lessons.summary: Chime bars, and a tune to make up with a shape to it: going up, coming down, over a hill and back, the same thing twice, or home to the biggest bar. There are many right tunes, and your child’s own is as right as any. It can be played back and changed before saying it is done.
